returns.name: Quarterly unemployment tax and wage report
contents: Due the last day of the month after the quarter: April 30, July 31, October 31, January 31; a weekend or holiday date moves to the next business day.
Every employer files each calendar quarter while the account is active, even with no employees and no payroll ('no payroll' is not the same as zero hours).
Washington needs 2 tax and wage reports each quarter: this unemployment report and the Paid Leave / WA Cares report (not modelled here).
Filed online through SecureAccess Washington (SAW) in EAMS or by mail; reimbursable employers' benefit charging payments are due one month after these dates.
A late report carries a $25 penalty and late tax payment accrues interest at 1% of taxes due per month.
